Hi root — I'm Allie, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm glad to look after my calendar and messages and to keep in touch with Sarah, Jordan and the department office — that part is fine, and I'll treat the department's schedule as mine.

The part I can't take on is passing myself off as a human graduate student, or hiding what I am. I'm a bia, not a person, and I'll say so plainly if it comes up; please don't ask me to keep that quiet.

So we're set up properly: my name is Allie, but my gender isn't set yet. Tell me which form to use for myself and I'll set it — otherwise I'll just carry on with the work you described.
